text:
Alex: Quick midday check — GPU capacity looks ok in us-west-2 for the day. I drained 2 machines for the kernel update, queue length stayed < 6 for p99.
Maria: Thanks Alex. Which instance types did you drain? Any spot interruptions? :thinking: 
Alex: Drained g5.4xlarge pool nodes. No spot interruptions — they were reserved for the test batch. CPU mem normal. Observed slightly higher tail latency for long-context jobs (~30% increase) while draining.
Chen: Noted — did the autoscaler spin up new nodes or did we use burst from dedicated pool?
Alex: Autoscaler created 2 new g5.4xlarge in the same AZ; we also pulled 1 node from dedicated-burst, which covered most of the backlog.
Sam: FYI I've got a quota increase request pending for eu-west-1. Any blockers for rolling it out today?
Maria: I reviewed the quota ticket. Looks fine, but infra needs to confirm region networking for private deploys. @Chen can you double-check VPC peering limits?
Chen: Will do in ~20m. I saw a warning earlier about route table entries hitting 200 — might be tight if we add more racks.
OpsBot: deploy:kernel-update completed on 2 nodes in us-west-2 by Alex at 2026-03-17T14:02:13Z :white_check_mark:
Jamie: Small blocker: can we reduce batching window for short-chat workloads? p50 is fine but p95 is rising during peak. I'm thinking reduce max_batch_time from 20ms to 10ms for those routes.
Sam: That should help latency. Could increase token cost slightly. Can you open a quick PR and we can canary it on the short-chat route?
Jamie: On it, will add rollout policy canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error rate > 2%.
Jamie: PR will change route config:
```
routes:
  short-chat:
    max_batch_time_ms: 10
    rollout: canary:5,25,100
```
Maria: Also remind infra to check AZ distribution when autoscaler provisions — earlier we got uneven spread causing temp hot-spot.
Alex: Agree. I'll add an alert: 'autoscaler_az_skew' if any AZ > 65% of running instances for a pool.
Chen: Quick note: eu-west-1 quota increase might need an increase in routes per VPC; reaching out to cloud rep. ETA 24-48h.
Sam: OK. If quota isn't in time, plan B: shift some jobs to eu-central-1. Is eu-central capacity healthy?
Alex: eu-central has free headroom for low-priority batches today. Will tag batch jobs with region_preference.
Jamie: Last thing — can someone ack the pending change for kernel driver 520.56? It's in the infra-changes doc.
Maria: Ack from me. @Chen you?
Chen: Ack. I'll schedule the rest of the fleet for the upgrade overnight to minimize traffic impact.
Alex: Great. No other blockers on my side.
Sam: Thanks team. I'll follow up on quota ticket and PR comments.
Maria: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
